summary: Join our SAP ERP Implementation and Best Practices Training Course. Equip yourself with the knowledge to streamline ERP processes and drive business success.
lede: SAP ERP implementation organizes the work of defining processes, configuring systems, migrating data, testing, and preparing for go-live. This course is for project managers, functional consultants, process owners, and data or test leads coordinating that work. It develops practical skills in mapping process scope and fit decisions, planning master data migration controls, and coordinating testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.
audienceIntro: SAP ERP implementation teams work across business, technology, data, testing, and change functions. This course suits professionals who need a shared implementation method without assuming advanced configuration or programming experience.
modules: SAP Process Discovery and Fit Analysis
prerequisites: This foundation-to-intermediate course requires basic familiarity with organisational workflows and ERP terminology. Coding is not required for completion. Advanced SAP configuration, ABAP development, complex integration engineering, and production deployment are introduced at conceptual or operational level, while process mapping, implementation planning, data controls, testing artefacts, and cutover planning receive hands-on practice.
